args.title: checkout-api rollback from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.2.9

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was deployed to production and is unhealthy; the previous healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rollback attempt to v2.3.0**: Rejected — v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417, so it could not be redeployed.
3. **Rolled back to v2.2.9**: The most recent healthy production release not under quarantine. Rollback succeeded and was verified in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the quarantined v2.3.0, the rollback to v2.2.9, and the verified recovery. On-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1's failure and the v2.3.0 CVE quarantine mean no newer release is currently safe to run — a fixed build will be needed before re-deploying forward.
